messages:
alex: heads up, deploy-bot just flagged the release.
deploy-bot: RELEASECHECK failed for rollout v2026.03.21-rc3: secret sentinel mismatch between staging and prod for key `inference/credentials/sentinel`.
alex: what exactly is different?
maria: quick check: in staging the sentinel value is `base64:AAA...` but prod has `hex:0a0b...`.
jordan: ugh, that's the old encode/normalize issue we thought was retired.
alex: did the preflight schema assert encoding type?
maria: preflight only checks presence, not encoding. I looked at the diff: staging preprocess pipeline writes sentinel with base64 marker, prod is older agent that writes hex.
sre-bot: related alerts: 2 instances in prod returned 401 when trying to retrieve KMS key alias with the new sentinel prefix.
jordan: that explains why the canary in prod returned auth errors earlier.
liz: this is during the 2pm change window; what's the rollback plan?
maria: options: 1) roll back to previous image (v2026.03.20) 2) patch prod secret to include a compatibility alias that matches staging encoding 3) abort rollout and run a quick migration to normalize sentinel reading.
alex: we need a fast, reversible move. Patch prod secret seems low-risk if we can do it atomically.
jordan: agree but adding a new secret alias touches KMS policy. Ops, can we add alias without infra change freeze?
sre-bot: adding alias will not require infra changes but will create an IAM audit event — fine within change window if approved by product.
liz: I approve adding a compatibility alias for this window. Need a blameless rollback plan on the ticket.
alex: @jordan can you create the alias and then we run a canary on 5% traffic? If canary passes for 10 minutes we proceed. If not, roll back to v2026.03.20.
jordan: on it. Command I'll run: ```aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/infer-sentinel-compat --target-key-id <key-id>``` then update secret to include `sentinel_alias: alias/redwood/infer-sentinel-compat`.
maria: I'll prepare a config patch and a short migration that lets runtime accept both `base64:` and `hex:` prefixes for 72 hours.
deploy-bot: noted — pausing rollout until manual resume by @alex. Current strategy: create alias + patch runtime + resume canary at 5%. If any 5xx or auth errors occur, rollback.
alex: thanks. Jordan, post the alias ARN here once done. Maria, add the migration PR link. We'll keep logs and runbook updated.
jordan: alias created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:alias/redwood/infer-sentinel-compat
alex: received. Maria, are you ready to push the patch?
maria: PR: https://git.redd.infra/r/redwood/runtime/+/merge/4521 — contains tolerant parser and feature flag `enable_sentinel_compat`.
liz: fine-grained rollout ok? Keep the release window notes updated: added compatibility alias and runtime flag to release notes.
alex: resuming canary at 5% now. deploy-bot: resuming rollout at 5% per approval.
sre-bot: monitoring: 2xx steady, no auth spikes, token latency normal.
jordan: no 401s observed after alias addition.
maria: canary healthy at 10 minutes. ramping to 25%.
alex: hold at 25% for 5 mins, then finish if no regressions.
deploy-bot: canary passed. finishing rollout.
liz: add follow-up: schedule a migration to normalize sentinel encoding across envs in the next maintenance window (owner: maria).
alex: decision: no rollback. We'll keep compat layer for up to 72h, then remove after migration. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
